reader.requirement: At --std 85 a READ of a sequential file executes only while the file is open in the input or I-O mode; a READ on a file never opened, closed (with or without LOCK), left closed by a failed OPEN, or open OUTPUT or EXTEND is unsuccessful with I-O status 47 (§1985:VII.1.3.5), takes no AT END path, and reaches an applicable USE procedure.

the AT END requirement in force at 85 (SR2, not this rule)

reader.notes: The open-mode test is one edition-free guard shared by every organization; at 85 it yields 47 for every non-input/I-O state probed, including after a failed OPEN, and a 47 reaches the USE AFTER ERROR procedure. The run-unit-termination arm for a 4x status without FILE STATUS was not exercised (implementor choice at 85).
reader.at-2023: same statuses for the non-CLOSE-WITH-LOCK legs (CLOSE WITH LOCK is refused COBOL0902 at 2023)
